flags.question: List the organizations that have a sentiment score above 0.8 in their latest article mention.
flags.cypher:
MATCH (o:Organization)<-[:MENTIONS]-(a:Article)
WHERE a.sentiment > 0.8
WITH o, a
ORDER BY a.date DESC
WITH o, collect(a)[0] AS latest_article
RETURN o.name AS organization_name, latest_article.sentiment AS sentiment_score, latest_article.date AS article_date
details: Cypher has ORDER BY (before final RETURN) but TypeQL has no sort

flags.question: Who are the top 3 parents of 'Julie Spellman Sweet'?
flags.cypher:
MATCH (p:Person {name: "Julie Spellman Sweet"})-[:HAS_PARENT]->(parent:Person)
RETURN parent.name AS ParentName
LIMIT 3

flags.question: Which 3 cities are mentioned most frequently in articles?
flags.cypher:
MATCH (a:Article)-[:HAS_CHUNK]->(c:Chunk),
      (o:Organization)-[:IN_CITY]->(city:City)
WHERE c.text CONTAINS city.name
RETURN city.name, COUNT(a) AS articleCount
ORDER BY articleCount DESC
LIMIT 3
details: Cypher uses CONTAINS but TypeQL has no like pattern

flags.question: List the top 5 organizations that have a subsidiary in the same city where they are headquartered.
flags.cypher:
MATCH (org:Organization)-[:HAS_SUBSIDIARY]->(sub:Organization),
      (org)-[:IN_CITY]->(city:City),
      (sub)-[:IN_CITY]->(city)
RETURN org.name AS Organization, city.name AS City
LIMIT 5

flags.question: Which organizations have been mentioned in the most negative sentiment articles?
flags.cypher:
MATCH (a:Article)-[:MENTIONS]->(o:Organization)
WITH o, AVG(a.sentiment) AS avgSentiment, COUNT(a) AS articleCount
WHERE avgSentiment < 0
RETURN o.name AS organizationName, avgSentiment, articleCount
ORDER BY avgSentiment ASC, articleCount DESC
LIMIT 10
details: Cypher sorts DESC but TypeQL sorts ASC (default)
Cypher uses COUNT() but TypeQL has no count

LIMIT 5

flags.question: List the articles that mention organizations with the most employees.
flags.cypher:
MATCH (o:Organization)
WITH o, o.nbrEmployees AS employees
ORDER BY employees DESC
LIMIT 1
MATCH (a:Article)-[:MENTIONS]->(o)
RETURN a.title AS title, a.date AS date, a.author AS author, a.summary AS summary
details: Question uses superlative "most employees" but TypeQL has no sort or max/min
Cypher has ORDER BY (before final RETURN) but TypeQL has no sort
